title: PlanCompleted
description: Immutable event emitted by the orchestrator when all plan steps have succeeded. Topic: conversation-events. Producer: orchestrator.ts. Consumer: aggregator.ts.

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the conversation (partition key)

sessionId.description: WebSocket session identifier carried forward for final delivery

results.description: Ordered array of all ToolInvocationResulted payloads collected during this plan
